rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for carrying people or goods from one place to another.

example.english: We will transport the goods to the pier tomorrow.
example.traditional: 我哋聽日運送啲貨去碼頭。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 wan6 sung3 di1 fo3 heoi3 maa5 tau4

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the act or process of moving goods or people.

example.english: The transport of this shipment needs to be arranged carefully.
example.traditional: 呢批貨嘅運輸要小心安排。
example.jyutping: ni1 pai1 fo3 ge3 wan6 syu1 jiu3 siu2 sam1 on1 paai4

rows.note: Use this for the public-transport system serving a region, rather than transport in general.

example.english: Hong Kong's public transport is really convenient.
example.traditional: 香港嘅公共交通真係方便。
example.jyutping: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 gung1 gung6 gaau1 tung1 zan1 hai6 fong1 bin6

rows.note: Use this when something moves a person deeply or stirs strong emotion, rather than physically carrying them.

example.english: This film really did transport me emotionally—I cried.
example.traditional: 呢套戲真係感動到我喊。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 zan1 hai6 gam2 dung6 dou3 ngo5 haam3

rows.note: Use this for a vehicle or means of transport; for sense 6 it covers the vehicles belonging to the public-transport system.

example.english: A bus is a very convenient means of transport.
example.traditional: 巴士係好方便嘅交通工具。
example.jyutping: baa1 si6 hai6 hou2 fong1 bin6 ge3 gaau1 tung1 gung1 geoi6
